name: Répcelak (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and yellow triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Répcelak: a crowned red and blue shield with a yellow lion and stars.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and yellow triangles
